leila: Heads-up — Quartz Garrison (customer) is scheduled for their private VPC cutover this Thurs 02:00-04:00 UTC. Planning checklist below, ping if you want the slot changed. :calendar:

ben: I can take the primary deploy lead. I'll be online for the full window.

priya: I can cover post-deploy smoke + data plane checks (02:30–03:30 UTC).

anya: I'll be standing by for rollback assistance and windows coordination. If we need DB fallback I'll drive it.

tom: FYI I'll be tied to another customer until 01:45 UTC, but I can jump on at 02:00 for the handoff.

frank: I'll own metrics/alert watching and the console dashboards during the window.

deploy-bot: Build #4827 passed integration tests on main and pushed to staging registry. Image: registry.redwood.io/quartz-garrison:2026-02-18-4827

leila: Quick ops-plan summary — please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm assigned pieces.
- Cutover approach: rolling update (blue->green), 10% batch, health checks on each batch.
- DB changes: none. config toggle flip only.
- Backwards compatible model: yes (v2 is backward compatible).
- Smoke tests: minimal latency and auth checks, synthetic queries.

ben: Confirmed. I'll run the deploy steps and cut traffic after green passes health checks.

priya: Smoke test commands (will run after green at ~02:25):
```
# health
curl -sS -H 'Host: api.quartz.garrison' https://private-gw.qz.example/health | jq .status
# short synthetic chat check
curl -sS -X POST https://private-gw.qz.example/v1/chat \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}],"max_tokens":8}' | jq .choices[0].text
# quick embed sanity
curl -sS -X POST https://private-gw.qz.example/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' | jq .data[0].embedding | wc -c
```

anya: Rollback plan if we see errors >5% or latency spike >2x for >3m:
- Pause traffic promotion, revert k8s deployment to previous image with `kubectl rollout undo deployment/quartz-api -n qz-prod`
- If config toggle flip is the cause, flip back using `/ops/config-toggle quartz-feature false`
- Notify customer and start incident bridge if rollout doesn't stabilize in 10m.

tom: Can you add the exact k8s image tags and the canary svc name in the runbook? I'll double-check RBAC perms before handoff.

ben: Image tags: registry.redwood.io/quartz-garrison:2026-02-18-4827 (green), registry.redwood.io/quartz-garrison:2026-02-16-4801 (blue/current). Canary svc: quartz-api-canary.

frank: Dashboard panels I'll watch: token latency p50/p95, error rate 5xx, outbound egress, per-route qps. I'll post live links in-channel at start.

ops-sre: I've scheduled the quiet window in PagerDuty for that timeframe and added a dedicated pd escalation (ops-sre -> platform-oncall). Make sure oncall handoff note is up-to-date.

leila: Small preflight items (do these by 01:30 UTC):
- ben: make sure the k8s job account has `rollout` perms.
- tom: validate network ACLs to customer VPC (no firewall surprises).
- priya: seed test keys into the private test vault path and verify retrieval.
- anya: confirm rollback playbook doc link and ownership.

ben: Done on perms, verified via `kubectl auth can-i rollout deployment --as=svc:deploy-bot -n qz-prod` returned "yes".

tom: ACLs checked, one minor rule needed for the new egress range; updated with infra, will confirm after rules propagate (~15m).

priya: Test keys loaded to `secret/qz/quartz-synthetics` and retrieval verified: `vault kv get -field=token secret/qz/quartz-synthetics` returns a token.

anya: Rollback doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quartz-garrison-rollback (updated). I added step numbers and expected timings.

leila: Perfect. On the day-of I'll kick with a 15m pre-window check-in at 01:45 UTC in this thread. Plan to post live updates as bullets.

ben: I'll post progress steps like: "1) start canary (02:00) 2) check health 02:05 3) 10% promotion 02:10" etc.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: private-vpc-cutover quartz-garrison in 24h (Thursday 02:00 UTC).

frank: I'll have mute alerts for non-critical noise and pin only the panels that matter.

leila: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD I'll lock the slot. :lock:

ben: :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup:

anya: :thumbsup:

tom: :thumbsup:

ops-sre: Noted. I'll be paged on the escalation chain if needed.

leila: Locking slot. See you on Thursday.
